checks.name: strict UTC defaults and malformed requests
flag exact true; default false
empty source returns null denominators and no cost rather than zero invoices
mixed provenance excludes every business amount, group, audit and denominator
forged and repeated client completion/reuse events do not affect metrics
session owner scope and missing/inactive membership rejection
classification correction appends and removes formerly business from all metrics
classification stale imports and cross-scope/REPLACE/update/delete blocked atomically
UTC start inclusive/end exclusive; finish after window end still in cohort
invalid completion time is missing, invalid creation time unwindowable
batch items count one invocation, repeated independent batch counts subsequent use
current product rename/archive does not change frozen groups
copied batch hash cannot hide mismatching source snapshot JSON or inflate reuse
atomic read does not incorporate later classification update
zero business completed leaves empty rates despite populated unknown cohort
controlled classification material rejects spoofing/conflicts/metadata and byte mismatch
actual routes auth/no-store/flag/status do not trust client parameters
DB failures return explicit incomplete 503 without fake zero report
actual SSR page redirects anonymous, hides disabled/foreign scope and renders enabled owner
classification CLI real entry, symlink and readonly exact local files
cohort limit refuses complete ratios; exact bound remains supported
negative first-decision wait and corrupt audit hashes are excluded with missing counts
business UTF8 snapshot byte overflow rejects; excluded unknown large snapshot does not alter business report
101 audit events reject complete metrics without truncating history to a ratio
finite cost values whose sum overflows reject rather than emitting Infinity or zero
total business snapshot byte budget rejects even when each record fits its own cap

limitations: Controlled business classifications only; test and unknown excluded from every business metric. Zero included business does not prove zero actual business.
Creation-time cohort; completion and reviews are current at sourceAsOf, including events after the window end. No historical status reconstruction.
SKU reuse is subsequent distinct workflow invocations inside this window; batch items are not separate reuse. No ranking.
First-decision waiting time is not actual human effort; time saved and ROI are not evaluated.
Detection estimates are not invoices, profit or revenue. Generation model source is unknown.
Source classification does not establish verified business value or visual quality. Low sample counts do not prove improvement.
